lines: Waiting for the perfect plan. The perfect *time.*
The perfect version before you *show* anyone.
#Meanwhile someone with half your talent just *posted* theirs.
While you were *polishing*, they were growing.
While you waited to be *ready*, they got better.
Fear of being *judged.* Fear of not being enough.
Perfect just sits in your drafts *forever.*
Your first version is supposed to be *bad.*
Your first video. Your first *business.* Your first draft.
#So ship it. Post it. Send it. *Launch* it.
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.

post.title: Perfect Is Killing Your Dreams
post.caption: Perfectionism is just fear in a nice suit. Ship it. 🚀
post.first_comment: What's sitting in your drafts right now? 👇
